<!-- pr-reviewer: 0ee89fb64d9b92431c92731534beb5e234d24fad -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change alters the finish-wall gouge check.
I found no code defect in the reviewed change. One required validation item remains open.

What looks good:

- The cone radius uses the deepest endpoint of an axial move.
- Model sections, tool axes, arcs, lateral feeds and untrusted cutter geometry retain the nominal radius.
- The app tests check both safe posting and refusal of a real wall gouge.
- No goldens moved. No UI, fixture, importer, dependency or process files changed.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream main `35d65e03be24407e9701cb6bafa5dedf79c6d72c` was clean.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3054`, with a separate target directory.
No GitHub runner was used.

`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 15 steps.
The selected suites passed 265 tests, with no failures:

| Crate | Suite | Passed |
|---|---|---:|
| sim | lib | 202 |
| sim | boundary_arc_planes | 3 |
| sim | boundary_arc_walls | 4 |
| sim | boundary_walls | 6 |
| sim | model_excess | 6 |
| sim | spot_drill_radius | 7 |
| app | coarse_rims | 5 |
| app | face_rim_hole | 2 |
| app | real_tip_contour | 4 |
| app | slot_caps | 4 |
| app | spot_drill_verify | 2 |
| app | thread_mill_rim | 13 |
| app | verify_arc_reading | 7 |

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` passed.
`git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

Extra suites run:

- No additional fixture or importer suites were required by the changed paths.
- After the mutations were removed, the complete `spot_drill_radius` suite passed again: 7 tests.

Mutations rerun by the reviewer:

1. Replace the deepest endpoint with the shallowest endpoint. The bore-enlargement test failed at `spot_drill_radius.rs:83`:
   ```text
   depth 1.5 enlarges the finished bore: []
   ```
   Restore the source: the same test passed.
2. Remove the stationary-XY guard. The lateral-feed test failed at `spot_drill_radius.rs:115`:
   ```text
   the axial cone rule does not clear a lateral or arc feed: []
   ```
   Restore the source: the test passed in the complete suite.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:93` and the PR body's Tests / Not exercised sections: run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Add their results to the PR body. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects the app and motion lanes because this source changes. The body states that ignored heavy tests were not exercised. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires these runs before the PR is ready. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and record the results, including any known-fail checks. The dry-run is not a pass. No heavy lane ran during this review.

The GUI, light lane, release gate and physical machine were not exercised.
The review applies the laws from current upstream main, not the PR's copy.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

Addressed: The review requested the reached heavy validation and its results in the PR body.

I ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head.
The app and motion lanes completed 234 steps.
The ordinary heavy tests had 97 passes and one failure.
All eight dedicated known-fail checks matched their expected failures.
I added these results to the PR body and corrected Not exercised.

The unexpected failure was `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` in `pocket3d_hsm`.
It failed at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`, before verification.
The expected Linux counts were `(4726, 4698, 549)`.
The actual counts were `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.

The quick gate rerun passed all 15 steps and 265 tests.
The clippy rerun passed in 1 minute 18 seconds.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` exited with code 0.

The head remains `0ee89fb64d9b92431c92731534beb5e234d24fad`.
No source changed.
This validation-only finding needed no new pins or mutation checks.
The heavy gate remains red, and the PR stays a draft.
Please review the validation results again.

The unexpected failure was `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.

Both checks used `upstream/main` at `08697d3c422a2f6ade1f3e1fd9970b16ed3177eb`.
No source changed. New pins and mutation checks do not apply to this validation-only finding.
The head remains `0ee89fb64d9b92431c92731534beb5e234d24fad`.
Please review the validation results again.
